title: Find the salaries above average
prompt: Return the first_name and salary of every employee who earns more than the average salary of all employees, highest salary first. The starter uses avg in WHERE, which is not allowed.
hints: Read the error. Why can WHERE not use avg directly?
A subquery in brackets can work the average out and hand it over as a single value.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Types today's average into the query, so it is wrong when salaries change.
Compares each employee with the average of their own department instead of all employees.

feedback: The average must come from all employees and be worked out by the query itself each time it runs.
